paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: : figure
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled “Researcher Location,” illustrates the number of datasets associated with researchers from various locations over the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the year, with labels for each year from 2012 to 2022. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of datasets,” uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ (1) to 10² (100), with tick marks at intervals of 10. The chart displays grouped bars for each year, with each group containing six colored bars corresponding to the researcher locations: “Other” (blue), “UK” (red), “USA” (orange), “IT” (purple), “IN” (green), and “DE” (brown), as indicated in the legend. The bars are arranged in chronological order from left to right, with no sorting by value. For each year, the height of the bar indicates the count of datasets for that location. The values are approximate and visually estimated from the chart: in 2012, only the orange bar (USA) is present at approximately 1; in 2013, the orange bar is at 1 and the blue bar (Other) is at 1; in 2014, the blue bar (Other) is at 1 and the orange bar (USA) is at 1; in 2015, the blue bar (Other) is at 1 and the brown bar (DE) is at 1; in 2016, the blue bar (Other) is at 1, the red bar (UK) is at 1, the green bar (IN) is at 1, and the orange bar (USA) is at 1; in 2017, the blue bar (Other) is at 10, the red bar (UK) is at 10, the orange bar (USA) is at 10, the purple bar (IT) is at 10, the green bar (IN) is at 1, and the brown bar (DE) is at 1; in 2018, the blue bar (Other) is at 10, the orange bar (USA) is at 10, the purple bar (IT) is at 10, the green bar (IN) is at 10, and the brown bar (DE) is at 10; in 2019, the blue bar (Other) is at 10, the orange bar (USA) is at 10, the purple bar (IT) is at 10, the green bar (IN) is at 10, and the red bar (UK) is at 1; in 2020, the blue bar (Other) is at 10, the orange bar (USA) is at 10, the green bar (IN) is at 10, the brown bar (DE) is at 10, and the red bar (UK) is at 10; in 2021, the blue bar (Other) is at 100, the orange bar (USA) is at 100, the green bar (IN) is at 100, the purple bar (IT) is at 100, the brown bar (DE) is at 100, and the red bar (UK) is at 100; in 2022, the blue bar (Other) is at 10, the orange bar (USA) is at 10, the green bar (IN) is at 10, and the purple bar (IT) is at 1. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color and height.
